Vakni stole into the heart of Gaea. Here would be the purest silk for Cruxius. She would prove to him that she was capable. She saw golden threads all around her. As she reached out to grab some of the threads, a voice rang out from behind her.

"What have we here then. A hellite, surely, but you are not the queen. What are you doing here? Speak up now."

Vakni hesitated only a moment. Two golden hands floated in front of her. Every joint on the hands seeped a fiery glow. On one palm, there was an eye, and on the other palm, a mouth. She reached for the key in her pocket, and suddenly she crashed to the ground. "You haven't answered me. I can't have you leaving just yet. What are you here for?"

Vakni could feel the weight of her own body crushing her. "Fulcrid silk!" she wheezed.

"Fulcrid silk? How did you know about that? You think having all research done near the core would prevent the prying eyes of mortals from seeing it, but I never expected one with the guidance of a god. Anyhow, if its silk you want, I'm afraid there's too little of it for the Queen to be willing to part with. As of right now, it's still experimental, and there isn't even much made.

But, the way you appeared right at the Fulcrum, as though through thin air, suggests that you must have teleported here using the tool of a god, correct. Yes, I can sense the immense power that emanates from the key you're trying to conceal, young Vakni. Tell you what, there was a task that would involve hundred of Fulcrid to complete that you could complete in a day with that key of yours. I need you to deliver these stone tablets all throughout Gaea.

These stone tablets are all engraved with one message, in all languages of every faction. These tablets are to be delivered to every major race on Gaea. I want them dropped somewhere where the leader of each faction resides, so that he or she may read it as soon as possible. In return for this, I will willingly give up a bolt of Fulcrid silk."

The gravity shifted again, and Vakni stood once more. "I...will do as you ask." Vakni took the tablets from one of the massive golden hands, and placed them in her pack.

"Return here when the task is done and you will have your silk, mortal."

Vakni turned from the hands, pulled out Sleipnir and opened the gateway again. She stepped through the portal and it closed immediately behind her.

A man appeared in the core beside the floating hands. He leaned leisurely against the wall, sipping from his cup. "Ambitious, that one, eh Tuum? She'll make a fine champion once she gets her head on straight. Thanks for not crushing her, by the way. It would have been such a waste of a hellite." Cruxius pulls one of the tablets from his pocket. "A coronation, huh? I'll have to find a present." Cruxius chuckled, and the tablet evaporated. "Don't worry. I put it back in her pack. She'll do what you want, but I do hope she hurries. I might have just the gift for the Queen." Cruxius laughed again. He took a long sip from his cup, stumbled forward drunkenly, and vanished.
